scripts.comment:verify: Everything CI runs, in one command. It exists because there was no way to run CI's set locally: `typecheck` is web only and `typecheck:mobile` is mobile only, and the packages had no root script at all — so a PR could tick the checklist honestly and still fail on a package that was never checked. That happened. Add any new CI step here as well as to the workflow.
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:mobile && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:mobile && pnpm typecheck:packages && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:tokens && pnpm check:fonts && pnpm check:rls && pnpm check:cycles && pnpm check:specs
